_note: Assistance programs for the hypothetical New River Valley flood. Statuses describe this hypothetical: federal aid depends on a declaration. Facts about the real 2024 Helene declaration (DR-4831-VA) are cited from FEMA. Never add a deadline the source does not publish.

programs.name: American Red Cross disaster help
programs.summary: Emergency shelter, food and support after a disaster.

response.text: Find an open shelter or a safe place to stay

recovery.text: Ask the Red Cross about recovery support

programs.name: 211 Virginia
programs.summary: A free, confidential service that connects you with housing, food, health care and other help across Virginia.

response.text: Call 2-1-1 for local help and places to stay

recovery.text: Call 2-1-1 to find local recovery help

programs.name: Flood insurance claim
programs.summary: Report the flood and your loss to your insurance provider as soon as possible. Take photos and videos of damaged belongings and property.
programs.status_note: Homeowner’s insurance policies do not cover flooding; flood coverage is a separate policy.

how.label: How to start a flood claim

response.text: Report the flood to your insurer when you are safe

recovery.text: Report your flood loss and photograph the damage

programs.name: FEMA Individual Assistance
programs.summary: Federal help for housing and other needs. Only available after a Major Disaster Declaration that includes your county.
programs.status_note: In this hypothetical, it depends on a federal declaration. In 2024, FEMA approved it for Montgomery, Pulaski and Giles counties and Radford (DR-4831-VA); registration for that disaster has closed.

deadline.note: If approved, FEMA announces a registration deadline.

recovery.text: FEMA aid depends on a declaration. Watch for a registration deadline

programs.name: SBA disaster loans
programs.summary: Loans for homeowners and renters whose property was damaged in a declared disaster area.
programs.status_note: Only in a declared disaster area.

recovery.text: SBA loans: only if your area is declared
